what_nemo_does.the_call: CALL ldf_slp( kstp, rhd, rn2b, Nbb, Nbb ) -- src/OCE/stprk3.F90:174, compiled at cfgs/GYRE_OMIP_L2_P3_SM_R38TRAZDFKT2/BLD/ppsrc/nemo/stprk3.f90:178.
what_nemo_does.what_state_it_reads: prd = rhd from CALL eos ( ts, Nbb, rhd ) on the line above (stprk3.F90:173 / ppsrc:177) -- the BEFORE tracers; pn2 = rn2b, the BEFORE Brunt-Vaisala frequency; and Kbb = Kmm = Nbb, so every geometry read inside ldf_slp -- gdept, gdepw, e3u, e3v, e3w and the ssh behind them -- is at the BEFORE time level (ldfslp.F90:143,161,212-215,226-231,290).
what_nemo_does.where_it_sits: OUTSIDE the RK3 stage loop. The three CALL stp_RK3_stg statements are stprk3.F90:195,200,207 (ppsrc:201,207,215), all AFTER :174. So wslpi/wslpj are computed ONCE per step and every stage reuses them.
what_nemo_does.how_the_matrix_gets_them: traldf_iso.F90:135 CALL traldf_iso_a33( Kmm, ah_wslp2, akz ) fills ah_wslp2 = zahu_w*wslpi^2 + zahv_w*wslpj^2 (traldf_iso.F90:296-297) from those ONCE-PER-STEP slopes; trazdf.F90:173 then reads zwt = avt + ah_wslp2 at every stage. Only the ahtu/ahtv w-point average and akz's e3w carry the stage's Kmm; the SLOPES do not.
what_nemo_does.at_kt_1: GYRE has ln_rstart = F and horizontally uniform analytic initial T and S, so the BEFORE-state slopes are exactly zero and NEMO's ah_wslp2 is IDENTICALLY 0.0 at every stage of step 1 -- measured on the round-37 record, absolute maximum 0.

what_legoesm_does_today: ocean_model_latlon_cgrid.py:6969-6970 sets _T_gm_in/_S_gm_in = T_mid/S_mid (=state_new.T/S, the forward-Euler predictor built at :4893 from the whole baroclinic tendency), :7195 builds the shared density/Jacobian from them and state_new.eta (the AFTER ssh), and :7277 hands both to compute_isoneutral_K33_latlon. So the slopes are rebuilt from a STAGE/PREDICTOR state where NEMO reads the BEFORE state, and the resulting K33 reaches 9.6620886711883531e-13 m2/s where NEMO's ah_wslp2 is 0.

the_change: In the ONE shared WS-RK3 program, the GM/Redi slope operand set becomes the step-entry (Kbb) state: the tracers _T_gm_in/_S_gm_in and the positional eta handed to gm_redi_density_and_jacobian, gm_redi_tracer_tendency_latlon and compute_isoneutral_K33_latlon. Computed once per step, reused by all three stages -- which legoESM already does structurally, since the call fires once (M1). No knob, no default preserving the old behaviour on the lane that runs NEMO's stage program. ASKED-BY-DIRECTIVE under the user's standing 'do as NEMO does'.
